product_metadata.title: The Best Things In Life Are Furry, Vintage Metal Sign
features: Great for your home, dog or cat house, living room, bedroom, den, man cave or anywhere you have wall space
Vivid colors that will never fade
Pre-drilled holes for easy hanging on the wall
Each sign comes in its own poly bag
description: This sign is perfect for cat or dog lovers and pet owners’ home and shop decoration. Profess your love for your endlessly cute pet with our equally-adorable metal poster! Signs are made of metal and have a vintage faux finished background which creates the illusion of an aged vintage sign. It is well made and displays beautifully. These signs are made with water transfer printing technology that have vivid color and will never fade. Each sign comes in a poly bag.
